battle.name: 智利獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 智利獨立戰爭始於一八一〇年聖地亞哥的政治動員，殖民政府與主張自治的革命者隨後發生武裝衝突。西班牙殖民兵隊裝備正式型號 Matchlock musket 的火繩槍，作為步兵近距離射擊的常規火器，並與刀劍等冷兵器併用。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 本篇把智利獨立戰爭界定為一段從1810年9月18日至1818年9月17日的軍事與政治過程，並非在1810年內打完的一場戰鬥。1810年的聖地亞哥公開市政會議先建立代替缺席君主行使權力的執政委員會；此時爭的是王位空缺下的自治權，1811年康塞普西翁的宣言才是第一場由前線軍隊公開宣布獨立的行動，1818年才由中央政府正式宣告獨立。智利原屬秘魯總轄區；1814年撤廢、1816年重新成立的拉普拉塔總督區又把它納入新的王行政區。戰區由聖地亞哥盆地、康塞普西翁、比奧比奧河和塔爾卡瓦諾港串聯，中央谷地決定首都與內陸軍隊的補給，海港則決定南部戰線能否得到火藥、砲彈、槍械與糧食。西班牙王室軍及省級民兵構成王派，後來的智利愛國派軍隊構成另一方；1810至1818年的決定性勝負主要在陸戰完成。
countriesEn: This account defines the Chilean War of Independence as a military and political process extending from 18 September 1810 to 17 September 1818, rather than a single battle completed during 1810. The open cabildo in Santiago established a governing council that exercised authority in place of the absent monarch. The immediate issue was autonomy during a vacant throne; the declaration at Concepción in 1811 was the first public declaration of independence made by a field army, while the central government formally proclaimed independence in 1818. Chile had belonged to the Viceroyalty of Peru. The Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, suppressed in 1814 and restored in 1816, then incorporated it into a new royal administrative unit. The theater connected the basin of Santiago, Concepción, the Biobío River, and the port of Talcahuano. The central valley determined the supply of the capital and inland armies, while the seaport determined whether the southern front could receive powder, shot, weapons, and provisions. Spanish royal troops and provincial militia formed the Royalist side, while the later Chilean Patriot armies formed the opposing force. The decisive military outcomes between 1810 and 1818 were achieved primarily on land.
people: 關鍵指揮關係在1810年先由何塞·米格爾·卡雷拉掌握，他於10月4日出任最高執政官。安東尼奧·帕雷拉率王派軍隊於10月19日在坎查拉亞達擊敗並俘虜卡雷拉，21日進入聖地亞哥，卡雷拉則於11月21日被處決。1811年，貝納多·奧伊金斯自倫敦返國，任北方軍總司令，並與胡安·詹塞尼奧·艾薩瓦於1月1日在康塞普西翁先行宣告獨立；5月王派軍隊奪回康塞普西翁後，奧伊金斯被俘，之後脫身。11月7日，何塞·帕爾多與胡安·何塞·卡雷拉在埃爾羅布萊擊敗帕雷拉，使王派無法迅速恢復對南智利的控制。加夫列爾·阿維萊斯、拉斐爾·馬羅托、馬里亞諾·奧索里奧與伯納多·阿烏馬達先後率領西班牙軍隊；奧伊金斯則在1817年整合拉蒙·弗雷雷、米格爾·薩紐魯與魯德辛多·阿爾瓦拉多，建立持續作戰的北方軍。聖馬丁沒有代替奧伊金斯指揮每一場智利戰役，他從門多薩提供遠征構想、部隊協同與側翼壓力，兩者必須分開理解。
peopleEn: Command leadership in 1810 was initially controlled by José Miguel Carrera, who became Supreme Director on 4 October. Antonio Pareyra defeated and captured Carrera at Cancha Rayada on 19 October, entered Santiago on the 21st, and Carrera was executed on 21 November. In 1811, Bernardo O’Higgins returned from London and was appointed commander of the Army of the North. Together with Juan Jansenio Ayzawa, he made the first public declaration of independence at Concepción on 1 January. After Royalist forces recovered Concepción that May, O’Higgins was captured and subsequently escaped. On 7 November, José Pardo and Juan José Carrera defeated Pareyra at El Roble, preventing the Royalists from quickly restoring their control over southern Chile. Gabriel de Avilés, Rafael Maroto, Mariano Osorio, and Bernardo Ahumada subsequently led Spanish forces. In 1817, O’Higgins brought together Ramón Freire, Miguel Zañartu, and Rudecindo Alvarado in an Army of the North capable of sustained operations. San Martín did not replace O’Higgins as commander in every Chilean battle; he supplied the strategic plan, operational coordination, and flank pressure from Mendoza, which must be distinguished from direct battlefield command.
kits: 裝備上，智利愛國派最常見的遠距步槍是英國Brown Bess燧發步槍，這種槍械在1810年前已長期列裝於英軍；它通常沒有制式刺刀，不能與西班牙帶刺刀步槍視為相同裝備。西班牙王軍步兵使用1802式及1808式燧發步槍，兩者皆為1810年以前或當時的真實制式槍械，智利軍也會接收繳獲的同型槍。炮兵主要使用四磅、六磅與十二磅青銅滑膛架膛炮，野戰與要塞的火炮口徑雖有差異，射擊方式仍是從炮口裝藥，發射實心圓彈，近距離則可使用霰彈。步槍彈藥包括紙包彈或散裝火藥配合鉛丸，炮兵則須確保火藥、 引火物、圓彈及霰彈能隨前沿供應。愛國派騎兵使用馬刀，另有以長矛作近戰武器的騎兵。作戰初期各部隊裝備並不完全一致，1817年後才逐步提高槍械與炮兵供應的共同規格。王派依靠塔爾卡瓦諾等要塞的預備彈藥和火炮，愛國派則依靠騾隊、車隊及後來取得的沿海運輸線維持遠征。
kitsEn: The principal long-range infantry weapon of the Chilean Patriots was the British Brown Bess flintlock musket, a service weapon used well before 1810. It generally lacked a standard bayonet and should not be treated as identically equipped to a Spanish musket carrying a bayonet. Spanish royal infantry used the 1802-pattern and 1808-pattern flintlock muskets, both real service weapons fielded before or during 1810, and Chilean troops also received captured examples. Artillery consisted principally of four-pounder, six-pounder, and twelve-pounder bronze smoothbore muzzle-loading guns. Field and fortress guns differed in caliber, but all loaded from the muzzle and fired solid round shot, with canister available at short range. Musket ammunition included paper cartridges or loose powder with lead balls, while artillery required a reliable supply of powder, ignition materials, round shot, and canister. Patriot cavalry used sabres, and some mounted troops also fought with lances. Equipment was not uniform across all units at the beginning of the campaign, and common standards improved only gradually after 1817. Royalist armies relied on prepared artillery and ammunition stores at places such as Talcahuano, whereas Patriot forces depended on mule trains, wagons, and, after their capture of the coast, maritime transport.
tactics: 1810年的王室戰線以中央谷地為主軸。帕雷拉由瓦爾帕萊索一帶沿內陸道路北上，卡雷拉則從聖地亞哥南下，雙方在塔爾佩利安卡附近的坎查拉亞達交戰。王派先用步兵火槍與炮兵維持正面，再由機動性較高的騎兵打擊失去陣形的愛國派，隨後占領聖地亞哥。1811年的北方戰役則圍繞康塞普西翁與伊塔塔河控制，愛國派雖能奪取城市，卻缺乏穩定港口讓王派重新投入兵力。1812年阿維萊斯控制塔爾卡瓦諾後，防守、海軍火力與沿海補給再次有利於王派；1813年胡安·何塞·卡雷拉在埃爾博爾多擊敗何塞·米格爾·卡雷拉，阻止後者向首都進攻。1817年奧伊金斯由門多薩越過安第斯山返回智利，於4月8日進入聖地亞哥，並在拉斯韋加斯德佩特羅阿取得快速勝利。10月蘭卡瓜之役初期，奧伊金斯曾擊穿王派中央兵力，但拉斐爾·馬羅托保留的預備步兵與騎兵反擊扭轉戰局，愛國派撤退並渡過邁普河。12月塔爾卡瓦諾與拉韋一線的勝利則切斷王派南部的海路，使智利能以港口接收武器和補給。1818年3月，北方軍先以奧伊金斯部正面牽制奧索里奧，阿爾瓦拉多部則利用王派縱隊之間的空隙轉入側後。第一次坎查拉亞達失利沒有消除整個計畫，塔爾卡瓦諾、奧查科與4月5日的邁普戰役接連削弱王派各部；8月16日第二次坎查拉亞達中，奧伊金斯擊敗奧索里奧，才使王派南部野戰主力失去重新集結的條件。
tacticsEn: The Royalist line of operations in 1810 was organized around the central valley. Pareyra advanced inland from the vicinity of Valparaíso, while Carrera moved south from Santiago, and they met near Tarpellanca at Cancha Rayada. Royalist infantry and artillery maintained the front, and more mobile cavalry struck Patriot formations after they lost coherence, followed by the occupation of Santiago. The northern campaign of 1811 centered on control of Concepción and the Itata River. Patriot forces could seize cities, but they lacked a secure port through which the Royalists could reliably rebuild their strength. After Avilés controlled Talcahuano in 1812, fortifications, naval fire, and coastal supply again favored the Royalists. In 1813, Juan José Carrera defeated José Miguel Carrera at El Bordo and prevented his advance on the capital. In 1817, O’Higgins crossed the Andes from Mendoza, entered Santiago on 8 April, and won rapidly at Las Vegas de Peteroa. At Rancagua in October, O’Higgins initially pierced the Royalist center, but reserves retained by Rafael Maroto counterattacked with infantry and cavalry, reversing the battle and forcing the Patriots to retreat across the Maipo. Victory in the Talcahuano-Rahue sector that December cut the southern Royalist sea route and allowed Chile to import weapons and supplies through the port. In March 1818, O’Higgins’s forward force contained Osorio while Alvarado moved into gaps between separated Royalist columns. The initial defeat at Cancha Rayada did not destroy the entire Patriot plan. Victories at Talcahuano, Ochaco, and Maipú on 5 April progressively weakened the Royalist divisions. At the second Battle of Cancha Rayada on 16 August, O’Higgins defeated Osorio and removed the principal southern Royalist field army’s ability to reassemble.
data: 可核對的日期依序是：1810年9月18日聖地亞哥公開市政會議成立執政委員會，10月4日卡雷拉出任最高執政官，10月19日帕雷拉在坎查拉亞達取勝，10月21日進入聖地亞哥，11月21日卡雷拉被處決。1811年1月1日，奧伊金斯與艾薩瓦在康塞普西翁宣布獨立；5月26日王派奪回康塞普西翁並俘虜奧伊金斯；11月7日埃爾羅布萊戰役阻止帕雷拉。1812年12月6日的塔爾卡瓦諾戰役後，阿維萊斯鞏固王派海港。1813年4月26日至27日，埃爾博爾多戰役擊敗何塞·米格爾·卡雷拉。1814年11月19日的大地震中斷政府運作與軍用物資調度；1815至1816年奧伊金斯在門多薩重新組織軍事力量。1817年4月8日他進入聖地亞哥，4月27日至28日取得拉斯韋加斯德佩特羅阿勝利，10月1日至2日敗於蘭卡瓜，12月6日取得拉韋與塔爾卡瓦諾方向的勝利。1818年3月19日第一次坎查拉亞達失利，3月24日至25日塔爾卡瓦諾戰役获胜，3月28日奧查科获胜，4月5日取得智利本土的邁普戰役勝利；8月16日第二次坎查拉亞達获胜，9月17日正式宣告獨立。1820年10月瓦爾迪維亞的舊王派據點投降，12月8日拉莫斯·德·薩拉斯相關的王室復辟軍在卡拉被擊敗。智利主要編制稱北方軍，王派後來使用南方軍等指揮名稱，再下分為步兵、炮兵、騎兵及獨立旅；現存戰報不足以支持各役統一而精確的傷亡或彈藥消耗總數，因此不採用單一數字。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology is as follows: on 18 September 1810, the open cabildo in Santiago formed a governing council; Carrera became Supreme Director on 4 October; Pareyra won at Cancha Rayada on 19 October and entered Santiago on the 21st; Carrera was executed on 21 November. On 1 January 1811, O’Higgins and Ayzawa declared independence at Concepción. The Royalists recovered Concepción and captured O’Higgins on 26 May, while the Battle of El Roble on 7 November stopped Pareyra. Following the Battle of Talcahuano on 6 December 1812, Avilés consolidated the Royalist port. The Battle of El Bordo on 26 and 27 April 1813 defeated José Miguel Carrera. The major earthquake of 19 November 1814 disrupted government operations and military distribution, while O’Higgins reorganized his forces in Mendoza from 1815 to 1816. He entered Santiago on 8 April 1817, won at Las Vegas de Peteroa on 27 and 28 April, suffered defeat at Rancagua on 1 and 2 October, and won in the Rahue and Talcahuano sector on 6 December. The Patriots lost the first Battle of Cancha Rayada on 19 March 1818, won at Talcahuano on 24 and 25 March and at Ochaco on 28 March, and won the Chilean Battle of Maipú on 5 April. A victory at the second Battle of Cancha Rayada on 16 August was followed by the formal declaration of independence on 17 September. The former Royalist stronghold at Valdivia surrendered in October 1820, and the restoration force associated with Ramos de Salas was defeated at Cala on 8 December. Chile’s principal formation was the Army of the North, while Royalist forces later used designations such as the Army of the South, with infantry, artillery, cavalry, and separate brigades beneath them. Surviving reports do not provide one reliable, exact total for casualties or ammunition expenditure in every action, so no single numerical claim is used.
cause: 戰爭的直接背景是1808年拿破崙入侵西班牙、國王退位及王位繼承權反覆中斷。馬德里缺少可正常行使權力的君主時，西屬美洲各地依序成立執政委員會，聖地亞哥也在1810年9月援用同一模式。這並不表示1810年已形成全國性獨立力量；卡雷拉、奧伊金斯、地方軍官與中央委員會對權力及對西班牙應採何種政策並不一致，帕雷拉等王派軍隊又堅持恢復原有統治。軍事上，愛國派必須奪取康塞普西翁、聖地亞哥、比奧比奧防線及塔爾卡瓦諾等補給節點，才能把地方武裝整合為可持續作戰的政府軍隊。英國武器與資金、聖馬丁在阿根廷方面的協同，以及奧伊金斯在1815至1817年的軍事整編，才使原本反覆後撤的行動轉化為具備國家軍隊形態的戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate background was Napoleon’s invasion of Spain in 1808, the king’s abdication, and repeated uncertainty over royal succession. As Madrid lacked a monarch able to exercise normal authority, governing juntas were established throughout Spanish America, and Santiago followed the same model in September 1810. This did not mean that a nationwide independence force already existed in 1810. Carrera, O’Higgins, provincial officers, and the central council disagreed over authority and policy toward Spain, while Royalist commanders such as Pareyra remained committed to restoring the existing system. Militarily, the Patriots had to seize Concepción, Santiago, the Biobío defensive line, and supply points such as Talcahuano before scattered forces could be transformed into a state army capable of sustained operations. British weapons and financing, San Martín’s coordination from Argentine territory, and O’Higgins’s military reorganization from 1815 to 1817 converted an often-retreating movement into a conflict conducted by an organized national army.
impact: 戰爭最重要的軍事影響，是塔爾卡瓦諾與比奧比奧以南的交通、海港和野戰指揮逐步脫離王派控制。智利北方軍因此能以中央政府為核心統一調度步兵、炮兵、騎兵與後勤，不再只依賴康塞普西翁或聖地亞哥的一時奪城。1817年控制塔爾卡瓦諾還迫使西班牙把兵力、運輸與砲兵集中在智利南部，從而減少其向秘魯及其他南美戰區增援的能力，並為聖馬丁的遠征提供戰略條件。1818年正式獨立宣言把此前各役形成的實際控制轉化為中央政府的對外法律地位。這個改變並未使所有舊王派武裝立即消失，瓦爾迪維亞與南部復辟行動仍需由智利軍在1820年處理，因此軍事統一與政治宣告不能視為同一時刻完成。
impactEn: The principal military effect was the progressive transfer of the roads, ports, and field command south of the Biobío away from Royalist control. The Chilean Army of the North could consequently mobilize infantry, artillery, cavalry, and logistics around the central government rather than relying only on temporary possession of Concepción or Santiago. Control of Talcahuano in 1817 also forced Spain to concentrate troops, transport, and artillery in southern Chile, reducing its ability to reinforce Peru and other South American theaters and creating strategic conditions for San Martín’s campaign. The formal declaration of independence in 1818 converted the effective control gained through these campaigns into the central government’s external legal status. This change did not make every former Royalist armed formation disappear at once. Chilean forces still had to deal with Valdivia and a southern restoration attempt in 1820, so military unification and political declaration cannot be treated as simultaneous events.
result: 通常史家把1818年9月17日視為智利獨立戰爭的正式終點，但軍事終止並非由單一戰役造成。1818年3月至4月的塔爾卡瓦諾、奧查科與邁普勝利拆散了王派南部各軍，8月16日第二次坎查拉亞達則使馬里亞諾·奧索里奧無法再建立集中野戰軍；到正式宣言時，中央政府已掌握首都、主要河谷、北方軍與南部海路，具備持續國家統治及對外作戰能力。王室勢力並非當日完全消失，瓦爾卡瓦諾一帶仍有舊軍，瓦爾迪維亞的據點直到1820年10月才向智利軍投降；拉莫斯·德·薩拉斯相關的復辟軍又在12月8日的卡拉戰役中戰敗。若以最後能組織王派野戰力量對抗中央政府的時間為準，延長至1820年的軍事清剿才真正完成。因此，正式獨立日期是1818年9月17日，主要王派野戰主力瓦解於1818年8月，最後具統一指揮能力的舊王派進攻則在1820年12月結束。
resultEn: Conventional historians place the formal endpoint of the Chilean War of Independence on 17 September 1818, but its military conclusion was not produced by a single battle. Royalist divisions in the south were separated by the victories at Talcahuano, Ochaco, and Maipú between March and April 1818. The second Battle of Cancha Rayada on 16 August then prevented Mariano Osorio from rebuilding a concentrated field army. By the formal declaration, the central government controlled the capital, the principal valleys, the Army of the North, and the southern routes, giving it both the capacity for continuous state government and external military operations. Royalist power did not disappear on that day. Former troops remained in the Valdivia region, and the stronghold at Valdivia did not surrender to Chilean forces until October 1820. The restoration force associated with Ramos de Salas was then defeated at the Battle of Cala on 8 December. If the endpoint is defined by the last organized Royalist field force capable of challenging the central government, the military liquidation continued through December 1820. Formal independence was therefore proclaimed on 17 September 1818, the principal Royalist field army was broken in August 1818, and the last old Royalist offensive under unified command ended in December 1820.
